kehillah_missing_parshanut_work_trigger = {
	$LIBRARY$ = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_date >= 300.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 250.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 500.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 800.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer } }
			}
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah } }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim } }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim } }
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah } }
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 1080.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_kuzari } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 1050.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekor_hayyim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_habahir } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_hasidim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_zohar } }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_owns_any_torah_work_trigger = {
	OR = {
		kehillah_owns_parshanut_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_talmudics_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_hashkafa_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
	}
}

# The current work has another already-studied work of the same field.
kehillah_study_torah_has_same_track_reference_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 1
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_mekhilta }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_yefet_commentary }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 2
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }

				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_seder_rav_amram }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_iggeret_rav_sherira }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_rabbenu_hananel }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_anan_sefer_hamitzvot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_kitab_alanwar }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_rashi_talmud }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_hilkhot_harif }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_mishneh_torah }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 43
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_sefer_yetzirah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_sefer_harazim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_emunot_vedeot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_kuzari }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_mekor_hayyim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_sefer_habahir }
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_sefer_hasidim }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a character with var:kehillah_own_library. The ransom pool holds a
# work his library lacks.
kehillah_lib_can_redeem_trigger = {
	var:kehillah_own_library ?= {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_targum_onkelos }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_mekhilta }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer } }
			}

				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_08 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_08 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_09 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_09 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_10 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_10 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_11 }

			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_15 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_15 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_16 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_16 } }
			}
			AND = {

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_17 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_18 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_18 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_19 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_19 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_20 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_20 } }

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_21 } }
			}

				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_22 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_23 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_23 } }
			}
			AND = {
				is_target_in_global_variable_list = { name = kehillah_ransom_pool target = flag:work_authored_24 }
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_24 } }
			}
		}
	}

# Per-work, scope a reader: the work argues for a tenet his rite prohibits.

	always = no
}
kehillah_sefer_work_heterodox_work_mekhilta_trigger = {
	always = no
}

	always = no
}

	rite ?= {
		has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_esotericism status = prohibited }
	}

			AND = { global_var:kehillah_wk_work_authored_01_tenet_b ?= 2 has_tenet_status = { tenet = tenet_baalei_hamiqra status = prohibited } }
